title: kissed american pineapple cobbler
description: a classic american dessert featuring caramelized pineapple and a hint of spices
instructions: preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
in a large bowl, mix together the brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
add the pineapple rings to the bowl and toss to coat with the dry mixture.
transfer the pineapple mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
dot the top of the pineapple mixture with the butter.
in a separate bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs and milk.
pour the egg mixture over the pineapple mixture.
bake the cobbler in the preheated oven for 35 minutes.
reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes.
remove the cobbler from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
